# Kat Team Events

> Professional wedding and party entertainment in Romania and the United Kingdom — DJ, live singer, MC, sound and lighting as one coordinated team.

Kat Team Events is an entertainment business based in London (UK) that travels to weddings, baptisms and private parties across Romania and England. The core team: DJ Kat (15+ years experience), live singer Diana Onofrei, and MC Iulian Arama.

## Services

- **DJ & music** — Full-evening music from emotional moments to the dance floor; requests welcome.
- **Live singer** — Pop, blues and traditional repertoire with Diana Onofrei.
- **MC & hosting** — Ceremony flow, announcements and guest engagement (Iulian Arama).
- **Sound system** — Professional PA for small rooms and large halls (d&b, Dynacord, SQ5).
- **Lights & effects** — Room lighting, smoke and CO2 effects.
- **Band extras** — Optional instrumentalists (saxophone, piano, violin).
- **Equipment hire** — Standalone rental of pro audio, lights and wireless mics (Shure UR4D, PSM300).

## Coverage

| Region | Event types | Notes |
|--------|-------------|-------|
| Romania | Nuntă, botez, petrecere | Travel to your venue — Bucharest, Cluj, Timișoara, Iași, Suceava, Piatra Neamț, Botoșani, Constanța, Bucovina, Moldova, Dobrogea |
| England | Weddings, parties | Travel to your venue — base in London NW4 |

## How to book

1. Check the availability calendar at https://katteamevents.com/#schedule or message on WhatsApp.
2. Share your date, venue and event type (wedding, baptism, party).
3. Kat Team Events confirms availability and package details by email.
4. The full team arrives with sound, lights and performance equipment.

## Pricing

Custom quotes per event (date, location, venue size, package). Contact for a personalised offer — no fixed public price list.
